_context.checkpoint: a control checkpoint with RANDOM weights (268.3 MB), generated from the same config so it has the real checkpoint's contract (1969 tensors + dataset_meta). The real 268,846,952-byte checkpoint is NOT in the validation environment and its Google Drive distribution route is unreachable from it.
_context.what_it_proves: the environment, the model construction, the checkpoint-loading contract, the repository's preprocessing, the forward pass, the output structure and the runtime cost
_context.what_it_does_not_prove: anything about landmark accuracy — the weights are random, so the coordinates are meaningless by construction and are not model output
_context.device: cpu (2 vCPU sandbox; the operator's i9-13900H will be faster)

workarounds: torch>=2.6 weights_only=True: registered the checkpoint's own numpy/codecs reconstruction primitives instead of downgrading torch or disabling the guard
keypoints_withheld: the 38 coordinate pairs were produced by random weights and are meaningless; they are withheld so they cannot be mistaken for model output. A real run writes them to reports/engine6_run.json
